programName: UAE Family Residence Visa (Sponsoring Family Members)
eligibilitySummary: Expatriate resident holding a valid UAE employment or investment residence permit sponsoring spouse, sons up to age 25, unmarried daughters of any age, and parents.
legalBasis: UAE Cabinet Resolution No. 65 of 2022 on Foreigners Entry and Residence Regulations

programName: UAE 10-Year Golden Visa (Real Estate & Business Investors)
eligibilitySummary: Property investors owning unmortgaged UAE real estate (or mortgaged with approved UAE bank) worth at least AED 2,000,000 (~$545,000 USD), or commercial business investors/entrepreneurs.
